Households · one or several cars · in French

Car logbook

For one car or the whole household: each service item falls due by date or by mileage, whichever comes first, with an indicative plan to adapt to the manufacturer's service book. French roadworthiness test (contrôle technique) dates computed from the rule published by the French administration, with the source and check date shown. Every expense (fuel or charging, servicing, repairs, tyres, insurance, tolls, parking), real consumption from one full tank to the next (L/100 km or kWh/100 km), cost per kilometre and per month, and a printable service history for resale. Prices are entered by you, never built in.
